summary: Run Portfolio V1, Portfolio V2, and Sanity CMS Studio as separate Docker containers with a unified docker-compose.yml for easy local development and deployment.
narrative: The portfolio repository contains two Next.js applications (V1 and V2) and a Sanity CMS Studio. Currently, running all three requires separate terminal windows, different package managers (npm for V1, pnpm for V2), and manual coordination. This PRD creates a unified Docker setup where each service runs in its own container, can be started/stopped independently, and shares the same Sanity backend. A root-level docker-compose.yml orchestrates all three with a single command.
principles: Each service runs in its own isolated container
Services can be started individually or together
Shared Sanity backend with consistent environment variables
One command to start everything: docker-compose up
One command to start a specific service: docker-compose up portfolio-v1
Volume mounts for hot reload in development
